metadata.document_title: R4 System Acceptance Test Specification for foxBMS BMS

SG-BMS-002.description: Prevention of overcharge and overdischarge conditions
SG-BMS-002.safe_state: Charge/discharge current limited to zero, contactors open

SG-BMS-003.safe_state: Current limited, contactors opened if threshold exceeded

functional_validation.title: Complete BMS Power-On Initialization Sequence
functional_validation.objective: Validate that the BMS completes full power-on initialization and transitions to operational readiness within specified time
preconditions: Battery pack connected with valid cell voltages
Power supply within operational range (12V nominal)
test_steps: Verify SBC initialization completes with watchdog active
Verify AFE daisy chain communication established
Verify initial cell voltage measurement cycle completes
Verify BMS transitions through INITIALIZATION to STANDBY state
Verify CAN status message indicates operational state
expected_results: MCU boots within 100ms of power application
SBC enters RUNNING state with FS0B released within 500ms
AFE communication verified for all ICs in chain within 1000ms
Cell voltages read and validated within 2000ms
BMS state reaches STANDBY within 3000ms total
functional_validation.pass_criteria: BMS reaches operational STANDBY state within 3 seconds with all subsystems functional

functional_validation.title: Complete Precharge Sequence Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate the complete precharge sequence from request to normal operation mode including voltage equalization verification
preconditions: External load connected with precharge resistor path
test_steps: Verify BMS accepts request and transitions to PRECHARGE state
Verify voltage rise on load side
expected_results: Minus contactor closes with feedback verification
Precharge contactor closes, inrush current limited
Load voltage reaches 90% of string voltage within precharge timeout
Precharge contactor opens after voltage equalization
Plus contactor closes establishing full power path
Total precharge time less than configured timeout
functional_validation.pass_criteria: Complete precharge sequence executed with correct contactor sequencing and voltage verification

functional_validation.title: Multi-String Connection and Load Balancing
functional_validation.objective: Validate correct connection sequencing for multiple battery strings with current balancing verification
preconditions: BMS configured for BS_NR_OF_STRINGS greater than 1
All strings with valid cell voltages within matching threshold
BMS in STANDBY or single-string NORMAL state
test_steps: Monitor string voltage matching for additional strings
Initiate second string connection via FBMS-SWE-BMS-095
expected_results: First string connects via normal precharge sequence
Additional strings connect when voltage within threshold
Each string connection verified via contactor feedback
Current distributes approximately equally across strings
functional_validation.pass_criteria: All strings connected with balanced current distribution within 10% tolerance

functional_validation.title: SOC Calculation Accuracy Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate SOC calculation accuracy throughout charge and discharge cycles including voltage-based recalibration
preconditions: Known initial SOC state (fully charged or discharged)
test_steps: Establish known initial SOC via voltage lookup at rest (ALGO-SOC-007)
Apply constant discharge current for measured capacity removal
Compare calculated SOC with expected value based on current integration
Allow battery to rest for relaxation period
Verify SOC recalibration via voltage lookup (ALGO-SOC-013)
Record deviation between coulomb count and voltage-based SOC
expected_results: Initial SOC correctly determined from voltage lookup table
Coulomb counting tracks capacity removal accurately
SOC deviation less than 5% after discharge cycle
Final SOC matches expected value within 5% tolerance
SOC value correctly written to FRAM for persistence
functional_validation.pass_criteria: SOC calculation error less than 5% throughout complete charge/discharge cycle

functional_validation.title: SOE Energy Estimation Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate SOE calculation correctly estimates remaining energy capacity accounting for temperature and aging effects
preconditions: Known battery capacity and initial state
test_steps: Record initial SOE at known charge state
Monitor SOE decrease against energy removed (ALGO-SOE-001)
Verify temperature compensation in SOE calculation (ALGO-SOE-003)
Compare SOE with energy meter measurement
Verify SOE correctly accounts for efficiency losses
expected_results: SOE decreases proportionally with energy removal
SOE accuracy within 10% of actual remaining energy
SOE correctly predicts zero at actual depletion
functional_validation.pass_criteria: SOE prediction error less than 10% throughout operational range

functional_validation.title: Cell Voltage Measurement Accuracy
functional_validation.objective: Validate cell voltage measurement accuracy across the full operational range using calibrated reference
test_steps: Apply known reference voltage to cell inputs
Trigger AFE measurement cycle (AFE_TriggerIc per AFE-API-001)
Read cell voltage values from database
Compare measured values with reference at low voltage (2000mV)
Compare measured values with reference at mid voltage (3400mV)
Compare measured values with reference at high voltage (4200mV)
Verify C-ADC and S-ADC readings match (AFE-ADI-019)
expected_results: Voltage reading error less than 1.2mV per AFE-ADI-004
C-ADC and S-ADC readings within 5mV per AFE-ADI-020
functional_validation.pass_criteria: Cell voltage measurement error less than 1.2mV across 2000-4500mV range
functional_validation.test_method: Requirements-based acceptance testing with calibrated measurement

functional_validation.title: Temperature Measurement and NTC Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate temperature measurement accuracy using NTC sensors with lookup table interpolation
test_steps: Apply known temperature to NTC sensors using thermal chamber
Calculate measurement error at each point
expected_results: Temperature measurement completes within AFE cycle
Temperature error less than 2 degrees C
functional_validation.pass_criteria: Temperature measurement error less than 2 degrees C across -40C to 60C range
functional_validation.test_method: Requirements-based acceptance testing with thermal reference

functional_validation.title: CAN Communication Protocol Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate complete CAN communication protocol including message transmission, reception, and error handling
test_steps: Verify periodic message transmission at configured rates
Capture BMS state message and verify content
Capture cell voltage messages and verify data encoding
Capture temperature messages and verify data encoding
Capture current limit messages and verify values
Send state request via CAN and verify reception
Inject CAN bus error and verify error handling
expected_results: Periodic messages transmitted at correct intervals (DRV-CAN-004)
State messages correctly encode BMS state
Current limit messages contain SOF-calculated values
State requests correctly received and processed
functional_validation.pass_criteria: All CAN messages transmitted at correct rates with correct content encoding

functional_validation.title: Cell Balancing Operation Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate passive cell balancing operation for voltage equalization across all cells
preconditions: BMS in CHARGE or NORMAL state
Cell voltage imbalance present (greater than threshold)
test_steps: Identify cells requiring balancing based on voltage difference
Verify balancing algorithm selects correct cells
Monitor balancing MOSFET activation on slave modules
Measure balancing current on high cells
Monitor cell voltage convergence over time
Verify balancing deactivates when threshold reached
expected_results: Balancing MOSFETs activated on appropriate cells
Cell voltages converge toward minimum voltage
Balancing automatically stops at equalization threshold
functional_validation.pass_criteria: Cell voltages equalized to within 10mV after balancing period

functional_validation.title: FRAM Data Persistence Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate critical data persistence across power cycles using FRAM storage
preconditions: BMS operational with valid SOC/SOE values
test_steps: Compare recovered values with pre-power-cycle values
Verify SBC initialization uses recovered state (SBC-039)
expected_results: SOC/SOE values written to FRAM with valid CRC
Power cycle completes without data loss
FRAM data read successfully on startup
SOC/SOE values match pre-power-cycle within tolerance
functional_validation.pass_criteria: All critical data persisted and recovered correctly across power cycle

functional_validation.title: Algorithm Execution Cycle Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate algorithm manager executes all registered algorithms at configured cycle times
test_steps: Verify total execution within maximum duration (ALGO-MGR-006)
Verify database updates with calculated values (ALGO-SE-004)
expected_results: All registered algorithms execute per cycle time
No algorithm blocked due to timeout
SOC/SOE/SOF values updated in database each cycle
functional_validation.pass_criteria: All algorithms execute within 100ms cycle budget with correct output
functional_validation.test_method: Requirements-based acceptance testing with timing measurement

functional_validation.title: State Request Processing Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate BMS correctly processes all valid state requests and rejects invalid requests
test_steps: Verify request transfer to state machine (FBMS-SWE-BMS-003)
Monitor state transition for valid requests
Submit invalid state request for current state
Test all valid state transitions from each state
expected_results: Request validated for current state legality
Invalid requests rejected without state change
Current state correctly reported via API
functional_validation.pass_criteria: All valid state requests processed correctly; all invalid requests rejected

functional_validation.title: Interlock Circuit Monitoring Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate interlock circuit monitoring detects open condition and triggers appropriate system response
expected_results: Interlock high-side driver active at pin 30
Voltage correctly scaled per divider ratio
functional_validation.pass_criteria: Interlock open condition detected within 1ms with correct system response

functional_validation.title: RTC Time Keeping Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate RTC maintains accurate time across power cycles
test_steps: Set RTC to known time value
Read RTC time and verify accuracy (DRV-RTC-003)
Execute power cycle with RTC battery backup
Read RTC time after power restoration
Verify time maintained across power cycle
expected_results: Time set correctly via I2C write
Time advances accurately during wait period
Accuracy better than 1 second per day
System time correctly incremented each ms
functional_validation.pass_criteria: RTC maintains time with less than 1 second per day drift

functional_validation.title: Humidity Sensor Integration Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate humidity and ambient temperature measurement via I2C sensor
test_steps: Read humidity value via DMA transfer (DRV-I2C-005)
Verify humidity measurement tracks environmental changes
expected_results: Humidity sensor state machine cycles correctly
functional_validation.pass_criteria: Humidity measurement accuracy within 5% RH; temperature within 2C

functional_validation.title: LED Status Indication Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate LED status indication correctly reflects BMS operational state
test_steps: Transition BMS through all operational states
Observe LED indication for each state
expected_results: Each BMS state has distinct LED indication
functional_validation.pass_criteria: LED indication correctly reflects BMS state

functional_validation.title: Port Expander I/O Control Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate port expander provides correct auxiliary I/O control
test_steps: Verify output state with external measurement
Toggle external input and verify reading changes
expected_results: Input pins correctly read external state
functional_validation.pass_criteria: Port expander I/O correctly controllable and readable

functional_validation.title: ADC Measurement Chain Validation
functional_validation.objective: Validate internal ADC measurement chain for analog inputs
test_steps: Apply known voltages and verify accuracy
functional_validation.pass_criteria: ADC measurements accurate within 1% of full scale
functional_validation.test_method: Requirements-based acceptance testing with calibrated measurement

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-001: Overtemperature Detection and Safe State (Cell Level)
safety_validation.objective: Validate cell overtemperature detection triggers complete safe state transition within FTTI
test_steps: Apply cell temperature above BC_TEMPERATURE_MAX_DISCHARGE_MSL_ddegC threshold
Start timing measurement at injection point
Verify BMS state machine transition to ERROR state
Verify all contactor feedback indicates OPEN state
Measure total response time from detection to isolation
expected_results: SPS channels for contactors show CONT_SWITCH_OFF state
Total response time less than 500ms FTTI
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Total response time from temperature exceedance to contactors open less than 500ms FTTI
safety_validation.test_method: Fault injection with timing verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-001: AFE Communication Failure Safe State
safety_validation.objective: Validate AFE communication failure detection triggers safe state entry
test_steps: Inject CRC error in AFE communication (corrupt isoSPI response)
Verify command counter mismatch detection per AFE-ADI-015
Verify measurement data marked as invalid
Verify contactor opening if error persists
expected_results: CRC error counter incremented for affected IC
BMS marks string measurement data as invalid
Contactor opening initiated if error persists greater than 3 cycles
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Communication failure detected within single measurement cycle (10ms); safe state if persistent

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-001: SBC Watchdog Failure Safe State
safety_validation.objective: Validate SBC watchdog failure triggers system safe state
test_steps: Monitor watchdog window timeout (128ms per SBC-022)
Verify FS0B assertion when counter reaches limit (8)
Verify MCU reset via RSTB if configured (SBC-027)
expected_results: Watchdog timeout detected by FS85 SBC
Fault error counter increments per bad refresh
FS0B asserts low after 8 bad watchdog events
System enters safe state with contactors open
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Safe state achieved within 8 x 128ms = 1024ms of watchdog failure
safety_validation.test_method: Fault injection with timing verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-001: Open Wire Detection and String Isolation
safety_validation.objective: Validate open wire detection triggers safe state for affected string
preconditions: Open wire check period elapsed (30000ms per AFE-API-008)
test_steps: Simulate open wire condition on cell voltage sense line
Monitor AFE-ADI-023 open wire detection with 470 Ohm pull-up
Verify diagnostic entry for open wire
Verify string isolation or system safe state
expected_results: Open wire detected via voltage comparison with pull-up active
If multiple strings affected, BMS transitions to ERROR
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Open wire fault detected and string isolated within 2 measurement cycles

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-001: Redundant ADC Stuck Value Detection
safety_validation.objective: Validate redundant ADC comparison detects stuck values
test_steps: Inject stuck voltage value to C-ADC measurement
Trigger voltage register read and comparison
Verify stuck register detection per AFE-ADI-017
expected_results: C-ADC vs S-ADC comparison exceeds threshold
Stuck voltage register detected (0x8000 per AFE-ADI-028)
Diagnostic entry created for measurement failure
Cell voltage marked as invalid (INT16_MAX per AFE-API-009)
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Stuck value detected within single measurement cycle

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-001: Interlock Open Triggers Contactor Opening
safety_validation.objective: Validate interlock feedback triggers contactor opening
expected_results: Interlock feedback change detected within 1ms cycle
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Safe state achieved within 500ms of interlock opening

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-002: Cell Overvoltage Current Limitation
safety_validation.objective: Validate cell overvoltage during charge triggers current limitation
test_steps: Inject cell voltage above BC_VOLTAGE_MAX_RSL_mV threshold
Monitor SOF voltage-based current limit calculation
Verify charge current limit reduction per ALGO-SOF-007
Verify SOF pack current limits set to zero at MSL
expected_results: Cell overvoltage detected within AFE measurement cycle
SOF calculates reduced charge current limit at RSL
Charge current limited to zero at MSL threshold
CAN message reports updated current limits
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Charge current limitation active within 100ms of overvoltage detection

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-002: SOC Limit Prevents Overcharge
safety_validation.objective: Validate SOC limits prevent overcharge at 100%
test_steps: Continue charging until SOC reaches MAXIMUM_SOC_perc
Verify charge current limit approaches zero at 100% SOC
expected_results: SOF reduces charge current as SOC approaches 100%
CAN message indicates fully charged state
safety_validation.pass_criteria: No overcharge beyond 100% SOC, charge current zero at full SOC

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-002: Cell Undervoltage Discharge Cutoff
safety_validation.objective: Validate cell undervoltage triggers discharge current cutoff
test_steps: Continue discharging until cell voltage approaches BC_VOLTAGE_MIN_RSL_mV
Verify discharge current limit reduction at RSL
Verify discharge current cutoff at MSL voltage
expected_results: SOF discharge current limit reduced at RSL
Discharge current set to zero at MSL
BMS remains operational but blocks discharge
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Discharge blocked at undervoltage threshold, no deep discharge

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-002: Low Temperature Charge Prevention
safety_validation.objective: Validate low temperature charge prevention (lithium plating prevention)
preconditions: BMS in STANDBY or CHARGE state
test_steps: Cool cells to temperature below charge cutoff threshold
Verify charge current set to zero
Attempt to force charge via external charger
expected_results: Low temperature detected below cutoff threshold
SOF charge current limit calculated as zero
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Charge blocked at low temperature, no lithium plating risk

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-002: High Temperature Charge Derating
test_steps: Heat cells to temperature above charge cutoff temperature
Verify charge current zero at MSL temperature
expected_results: High temperature detected above cutoff threshold
Charge current set to zero at MSL temperature
Diagnostic entry for high temperature if persists
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Charge current limited proportionally to temperature, thermal protection maintained

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-002: Deep Discharge Flag Persistence
safety_validation.objective: Validate deep discharge protection via FRAM flag persistence
preconditions: Battery voltage approaching deep discharge threshold
test_steps: Allow battery to discharge to deep discharge threshold
Verify deep discharge flag set in FRAM (DRV-FRAM-006)
Verify BMS reads deep discharge flag on startup
Verify restricted operation until battery recharged
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Deep discharge protection persists across power cycles

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-003: Overcurrent Detection and Safe State
safety_validation.objective: Validate current limitation check triggers safe state on violation
test_steps: Verify BMS response to current violation
Measure response time to contactor opening

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-003: Current Sensor Presence Detection
safety_validation.objective: Validate current sensor presence detection and degraded mode operation
test_steps: Verify current sensor CAN message reception
Verify BMS detects missing current sensor
Verify degraded mode operation without sensor
expected_results: Current sensor presence flag correctly set when connected
BMS uses current sensor data when present
BMS detects sensor loss when disconnected
BMS enters degraded mode if sensor missing
Diagnostic entry for missing current sensor
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Current sensor presence correctly detected, degraded mode active if missing

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-003: Limp Home Current Mode
safety_validation.objective: Validate limp home current mode on low temperature discharge
test_steps: Cool cells to temperature in limp home range
Monitor SOF discharge current limit calculation
Verify limp home current limit applied (ALGO-SOF-008)
expected_results: Temperature in limp home range detected
Full discharge restored when temperature rises
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Limp home current correctly applied in cold conditions

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-003: Pack Current Limit from String Minimums
safety_validation.objective: Validate pack current limits calculated from string minimums
test_steps: Configure different voltage/temperature conditions per string
Monitor SOF per-string current limit calculation
Verify pack current = sum of string minimums (ALGO-SOF-015)
Verify weakest cell limits pack current
Verify CAN message reports correct pack limits
expected_results: Pack current limit is sum of string minimums
Weakest cell in any string limits pack
CAN reports correct pack current limits
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Pack current correctly limited by weakest cell across all strings

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-003: Moving Average Overcurrent Filtering
safety_validation.objective: Validate moving average current calculation filters transients
test_steps: Apply varying current over time windows (1s, 5s, 10s, 30s, 60s per ALGO-MA-001)
Inject transient current spike below threshold
Verify transient filtered by moving average
expected_results: Moving average calculated over all time windows
Sustained overcurrent detected and acted upon
safety_validation.pass_criteria: Moving average correctly filters transients while detecting sustained overcurrent

safety_validation.title: SG-BMS-003: Zero Current Limits During ERROR Transition
safety_validation.objective: Validate zero current limits during ERROR state transition
test_steps: Trigger fault condition causing ERROR transition
Monitor SOF pack current limits during transition (ALGO-SOF-014)
Verify all current limits set to zero
Verify CAN reports zero current limits
expected_results: ERROR transition detected by SOF module
All pack current limits set to 0mA
CAN message indicates zero current limits
safety_validation.pass_criteria: All current limits zero during ERROR transition, immediate load shedding

performance_validation.title: 1ms HAL Task Timing Validation
performance_validation.objective: Validate HAL 1ms task timing performance meets requirements
test_steps: Monitor 1ms task execution start times over 1000 cycles
Measure task execution duration for each 1ms task
expected_results: Task starts within 50us of scheduled time
Jitter less than 100us (10%) over measurement period
LED toggle function executes each ms
RTC system time increments each ms
performance_validation.pass_criteria: 1ms task timing maintained with less than 10% jitter
performance_validation.test_method: Resource usage verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

performance_validation.title: 10ms BMS Task Timing Validation
performance_validation.objective: Validate BMS 10ms task timing performance meets requirements
test_steps: Measure worst-case execution time over extended period
expected_results: SBC trigger executes within same cycle
SPS control executes within same cycle
performance_validation.pass_criteria: 10ms task timing maintained with less than 5% jitter
performance_validation.test_method: Resource usage verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

performance_validation.title: 100ms Algorithm Task Timing Validation
performance_validation.objective: Validate algorithm 100ms task timing performance meets requirements
test_steps: Verify total execution less than max duration
expected_results: Total less than configured max duration
performance_validation.pass_criteria: 100ms algorithm cycle completed within timing budget
performance_validation.test_method: Resource usage verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

performance_validation.title: Stack Usage Margin Validation
performance_validation.objective: Validate stack usage across all tasks maintains safety margin
test_steps: Measure stack high water marks for each task
expected_results: Stack usage less than 80% of allocated
performance_validation.pass_criteria: All task stacks have greater than 20% margin
performance_validation.test_method: Resource usage verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

performance_validation.title: CPU Load Validation Under All Modes
performance_validation.objective: Validate CPU load maintains margin under all operational modes
test_steps: Calculate total CPU usage in steady-state operation
Record peak CPU usage in each mode
expected_results: Error handling CPU load less than 90%
performance_validation.pass_criteria: CPU load maintains greater than 10% margin in all modes
performance_validation.test_method: Resource usage verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

performance_validation.title: Safety-Critical WCET Validation
performance_validation.objective: Validate worst-case execution time for safety-critical functions meets FTTI budget
test_steps: Measure BMS state machine cycle time
expected_results: BMS state cycle less than 5ms execution
All less than 50% of FTTI budget
performance_validation.pass_criteria: All safety-critical WCETs within FTTI timing budget with 50% margin
performance_validation.test_method: Resource usage verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

performance_validation.title: AFE Communication Timing Validation
performance_validation.objective: Validate SPI/DMA transfer timing for AFE communication meets requirements
test_steps: Measure total AFE read cycle time
expected_results: AFE read cycle less than 5ms for full daisy chain
isoSPI wakeup less than 100us after sleep
performance_validation.pass_criteria: AFE communication completes within timing constraints
performance_validation.test_method: Resource usage verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

performance_validation.title: MCU Delay Function Accuracy Validation
performance_validation.objective: Validate MCU delay function accuracy across range
test_steps: Measure MCU_Delay_us(100) accuracy with GPIO toggle
Test across range of delay values
performance_validation.pass_criteria: MCU timing functions accurate within specified tolerance
performance_validation.test_method: Resource usage verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

performance_validation.title: Contactor Response Time Validation
performance_validation.objective: Validate contactor open and close response times meet specifications
test_steps: Measure time from command to feedback indicating closed
Measure time from command to feedback indicating open
performance_validation.pass_criteria: Contactor open less than 50ms, close less than 100ms for all contactors
performance_validation.test_method: Resource usage verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

performance_validation.title: End-to-End Response Time Validation
performance_validation.objective: Validate complete end-to-end fault detection to safe state timing
preconditions: Timing measurement capability from fault injection to contactor open
test_steps: Stop timing at contactor feedback open
performance_validation.pass_criteria: Total end-to-end response time less than 500ms FTTI for SG-BMS-001
performance_validation.test_method: End-to-end timing verification per ISO 26262-4 Table 8

environmental_validation.title: Low Temperature Operation Validation (-40C)
environmental_validation.objective: Validate BMS operates correctly at minimum temperature limit
preconditions: BMS and battery pack installed in chamber
test_steps: Soak BMS at -40C for minimum 2 hours
Power on BMS and verify initialization
Execute limited discharge operation (limp home mode)
expected_results: Charge blocked per low temperature protection
environmental_validation.pass_criteria: BMS fully functional at -40C with correct temperature-based protections active

environmental_validation.title: High Temperature Operation Validation (+85C)
environmental_validation.objective: Validate BMS operates correctly at maximum temperature limit
test_steps: Soak BMS at +85C for minimum 2 hours
Power on BMS and verify initialization
Monitor for thermal drift or instability
expected_results: SOF derating active at high temperature
environmental_validation.pass_criteria: BMS fully functional at +85C with correct temperature derating active

environmental_validation.title: Temperature Cycling Robustness
environmental_validation.objective: Validate BMS survives temperature cycling without degradation
preconditions: Environmental chamber with rapid thermal cycling capability
test_steps: Cycle rate: 30 minutes cold soak, 30 minutes hot soak
Monitor BMS operation continuously during cycling
Perform functional test after every 10 cycles
Perform complete functional test after all cycles
expected_results: Functional tests pass at each checkpoint
environmental_validation.pass_criteria: BMS maintains full functionality through 100 temperature cycles

environmental_validation.title: Supply Voltage Variation Validation
environmental_validation.objective: Validate BMS operates correctly across supply voltage range
environmental_validation.pass_criteria: BMS operates correctly across 9V to 16V supply range

environmental_validation.title: Supply Voltage Transient Immunity
environmental_validation.objective: Validate BMS survives automotive supply voltage transients
test_steps: Monitor BMS operation during each transient
Verify no data corruption or state machine upset
Verify FRAM data integrity after transients
expected_results: Switching transients do not cause malfunction
environmental_validation.pass_criteria: BMS survives all ISO 7637-2 transients without permanent damage or data loss

environmental_validation.title: Humidity Robustness Validation
environmental_validation.objective: Validate BMS operates correctly under high humidity conditions
environmental_validation.pass_criteria: BMS operates correctly at 95% RH without insulation breakdown

environmental_validation.title: Vibration Robustness Validation
environmental_validation.objective: Validate BMS survives automotive vibration profiles
preconditions: BMS mounted per automotive fixture requirements
test_steps: Apply random vibration per ISO 16750-3 profile
environmental_validation.pass_criteria: BMS maintains functionality during and after automotive vibration exposure

environmental_validation.title: EMC Immunity Validation
environmental_validation.objective: Validate BMS immune to electromagnetic interference
test_steps: Perform bulk current injection per ISO 11452-4
Monitor BMS operation during each test
expected_results: BMS operates through radiated immunity test
BMS operates through conducted immunity test
environmental_validation.pass_criteria: BMS maintains full functionality during EMC immunity testing

environmental_validation.title: ESD Immunity Validation
environmental_validation.objective: Validate BMS immune to electrostatic discharge
preconditions: BMS accessible for contact and air discharge
test_steps: Apply contact discharge (+/- 4kV) to all accessible points
Apply air discharge (+/- 8kV) to all accessible surfaces
Perform functional test after all discharges
expected_results: Functional test passes after ESD exposure
environmental_validation.pass_criteria: BMS survives ESD testing without permanent damage

environmental_validation.title: Power Cycling Robustness Validation
environmental_validation.objective: Validate BMS survives repeated power cycling without degradation
test_steps: Verify BMS initializes correctly each cycle
Verify FRAM data persistence across cycles
Perform full functional test after 100, 500, 1000 cycles
expected_results: FRAM data maintained across all cycles
environmental_validation.pass_criteria: BMS survives 1000 power cycles with 100% initialization success

end_to_end_scenario_tests.title: Complete Normal Operation Cycle
end_to_end_scenario_tests.description: Full cycle from power-on through charging, driving, and shutdown
scenario_steps: Power on BMS - verify initialization sequence
Connect charger - verify precharge and charge mode entry
Complete charging cycle - verify SOC reaches 100% with charge termination
Disconnect charger - verify state transition to standby
Connect load - verify precharge and normal operation
Complete drive cycle with varying load - verify SOC tracking and current limits
Normal shutdown - verify contactor opening sequence and state persistence

end_to_end_scenario_tests.title: Fault Injection and Recovery Scenario
end_to_end_scenario_tests.description: Systematic fault injection covering all safety-critical failure modes
scenario_steps: Start in normal operation
Inject AFE communication fault - verify detection and recovery
Inject cell overvoltage - verify protection activation
Inject cell undervoltage - verify protection activation
Inject overtemperature - verify safe state entry within FTTI
Inject SBC watchdog miss - verify reset and recovery
Inject interlock open - verify contactor opening
Verify system recovery after fault clearance

end_to_end_scenario_tests.title: Multi-String Operation and Balancing Scenario
end_to_end_scenario_tests.description: Multi-string connection, load balancing, and cell balancing operation
scenario_steps: Initialize with multiple strings available
Connect first string via precharge
Verify current measurement on first string
Connect additional strings - verify voltage matching
Apply load - verify current sharing across strings
Introduce cell imbalance - verify balancing activation
Monitor balancing until equalization complete
Disconnect strings in sequence - verify orderly shutdown

end_to_end_scenario_tests.title: Temperature Extreme Operation Scenario
end_to_end_scenario_tests.description: Operation across full temperature range with protection verification
scenario_steps: Start at nominal temperature (25C)
Cool to -30C - verify limp home mode activation
Attempt charge at -30C - verify charge blocked
Cool to -40C - verify minimum operation
Warm to nominal - verify full capability restoration
Heat to +50C - verify charge derating activation
